text:
Building a startup and not sure where investor money is going right now?

Launch Scout is a venture radar in Telegram. Every hour it pulls fresh funding rounds and shows you:
• which niches are overheated and where the window is still open
• who raised how much in your space
• whether your idea is worth building: /check tries to disprove it first

Facts, not opinions: every number links to a source.

Check your idea → t.me/Launch_Scout_bot?start=threads_en
